summary.text: JP Woodruff is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 92 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An entrepreneur, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he supports ending property taxes.

paragraphs.text: JP Woodruff earned a high school diploma from Arlington High School, and his career experience includes working as an entrepreneur.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Woodruff described himself as a fifth-generation Texan and third-generation Arlington resident.
Woodruff advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
In the survey, he listed ending property taxes and holding criminals, including corrupt politicians, accountable among his goals.
